summary: A pre-sign worker for the signing host: two systemd user timers (light every 2 min, heavy every 5 min) sign one ready pull request head of the host's own authors per tick with scripts/st-test --push origin, newest first, never a fork or an outside author, never the same tree twice, within operations' load limits, with a JSON line per attempt and a coverage summary.

replay.detail: No record or signature format changes: the notes are the ones st-test already makes.

schema.detail: No stored or wire format changes; the worker keeps its own local state files under ~/.local/state/evidence-presign.

rules.detail: What counts as evidence is unchanged; the worker signs as the host key st-test already uses, at the same levels and lanes.

compatibility.detail: Nothing runs until the units are installed on a host and ~/.config/evidence-presign/authors lists a login.

manual.detail: On the signing host, after sign-off: write ~/.config/evidence-presign/authors, copy scripts/evidence-presign-timer to ~/.local/bin and the four unit files to ~/.config/systemd/user, then systemctl --user enable --now evidence-presign-light.timer evidence-presign-heavy.timer.

recovery.detail: touch ~/.config/evidence-presign/off stops every tick; systemctl --user disable --now the two timers removes it.
